name: cmpc-libros
description: CMPC Libros — inventario de la tienda

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.test:cov: npm --prefix apps/api run test:cov && npm --prefix apps/web run test:cov
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
